title: §.XI Chemnitz: Same 1542 edition tabled at Worms as the AC; opposed to foes at Ratisbon — by Luther's counsel, approval, and consent
pass_a_gloss: That Edition in the same year, under the name of the Augsburg Confession, was proposed at Worms; the same Edition in the Colloquy of Regensburg they opposed to the adversaries as the form of the Doctrine of our Churches. And that was done by counsel, with Luther's approval and consent.
pass_b_english: "That same year the edition was laid on the table at Worms under the name of the Augsburg Confession.
At the Regensburg colloquy they set the same edition against their adversaries as the form of our churches' doctrine.
And that was done by counsel — with Luther's approval and consent."
source_text: Illa Editio eodem anno, nomine Confessionis Augustanae, proposita est Wormatiae; eandem Editionem in Colloquio Ratisbonensi, ut formam Doctrinae nostrarum Ecclesiarum, opposuerunt adversariis. Et factum illud fuit de Consilio, Lutheri approbatione & Consensu.
